meaning: Awesome, amazing; also "no way!" for big news (good or bad).

examples.en: Wow, this concert is seriously amazing!
You got everything right on the test? No way!

meaning: "OMG" / "What?!" — a reaction of shock or disbelief.

examples.en: OMG, I left my wallet at home.
What?! It's already midnight?

meaning: Super fun or entertaining (literally "honey fun").

examples.en: This drama is so much fun.
Yesterday's party was a blast.

meaning: Boring, not fun (from English "no" + 재미 "fun").

examples.en: That movie was more boring than I expected.
Today's class is so boring.

meaning: "Have a tasty lunch!" — short for 맛있는 점심. Common in office chats.

examples.en: Enjoy your lunch, everyone!
Did you have a nice lunch today?

meaning: "Fire Friday" — Friday night, time to go out and have fun.

examples.en: It's Friday night, what are you up to?
Hongdae is packed because it's Friday night.

meaning: Fried chicken and beer (치킨 + 맥주), a classic Korean combo.

examples.en: How about chicken and beer by the Han River?
Watching soccer means chicken and beer.

meaning: Short for "I'll drink iced americano even if I freeze to death." Someone who always orders iced coffee.

examples.en: You drink iced americano in midwinter? You're a true eoljuga.
I'm an eoljuga, so I always order iced.

meaning: When the mood suddenly turns awkward (갑자기 분위기 싸해짐).

examples.en: That joke made the mood suddenly awkward.
Things got awkward out of nowhere during the meeting.

meaning: A popular, outgoing person who is "in" with the crowd (from "insider").

examples.en: They're super popular at school.

examples.ko: 요즘 인싸들은 다 이 앱 써.
examples.en: All the cool kids use this app these days.

meaning: A loner or outsider (from "outsider"). Often used to describe yourself jokingly.

examples.en: I was a total loner in college.
I'm a bit of a loner, so I eat lunch alone.

meaning: A "something" — the stage before dating when two people like each other.

examples.en: Do you have a thing going with someone lately?
We're just in the "talking" stage.

meaning: A guy friend who is just a friend (남자 사람 친구). Female version: 여사친.

examples.en: He's just a guy friend, don't get the wrong idea.
I'm going to the movies with a guy friend.

meaning: Someone who falls in love very quickly (금방 사랑에 빠지는 사람).

examples.en: I fall for people fast, so I've got a crush again.
They fall in love way too easily.

meaning: A preachy, condescending older person or boss who insists on "how things used to be." Insulting.

examples.en: Our department head is such a kkondae.
I don't want to sound preachy, but come early.

meaning: "You can do it!" — encouragement (from English "fighting").

examples.en: Good luck with your interview, you got this!
Do your best today too!

meaning: A cheesy "dad joke," usually a pun.

examples.en: Another dad joke? Not funny at all.
Our team leader loves dad jokes.

meaning: "Extremely disgusting" / "I absolutely hate it." Strong and harsh.

examples.en: I absolutely hate cockroaches.
Saying things like that is gross.

meaning: A mental breakdown or meltdown; feeling completely overwhelmed (멘탈 붕괴).

examples.en: I lost my visa documents and totally panicked.
I froze when I saw the exam questions.

meaning: A small but certain happiness (작지만 확실한 행복), like a good coffee.

examples.ko: 퇴근 후 맥주 한 잔이 내 소확행이야.
examples.en: A beer after work is my little happiness.
Sleeping in on weekend mornings is a small joy.

meaning: Work-life balance (from English).

examples.en: This company has good work-life balance.
I changed jobs for better work-life balance.

meaning: Eating alone (혼자 + 밥). Similar: 혼술 (drinking alone).

examples.en: I'm going to eat alone today.
This restaurant is great for eating alone.

meaning: "Hurry, hurry!" — also describes Korea's fast-paced culture.

examples.en: Hurry! The bus is coming!
I've gotten used to Korea's ppalli-ppalli culture.

meaning: "Mom's friend's son" — the annoyingly perfect person you're always compared to. Female: 엄친딸.

examples.en: He's smart and handsome, a real "mom's friend's son."
Please don't compare me to the perfect kid.

meaning: "Didn't ask, don't care" (안 물어봤고 안 궁금해). Dismissive.

examples.en: I didn't ask about your love life, and I don't care.
Didn't ask, stop talking.

meaning: An eager, polite "Yes!" used in work messages; softer than 네.

examples.en: Yes, I've checked it!
Yes, I'll send it to you by tomorrow.

meaning: "Is this for real?!" — used when something is unbelievable.

examples.en: Is this price for real?
It's already Friday? Seriously?

meaning: "National rule" — an unwritten rule everyone follows.

examples.en: Soju with samgyeopsal is the unwritten rule.
The last song at karaoke is always a ballad.

meaning: Living a highly productive, disciplined life ("god" + 인생 "life").

examples.en: These days I wake up at 6 and live my best productive life.
Starting my "productive life" project!

meaning: "So annoying!" — a playful, exaggerated way to say something irritates you.

examples.ko: 친구가 내 과자 다 먹었어. 킹받네.
examples.en: My friend ate all my snacks. So annoying.
That face is seriously annoying.
